text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fan letters and a string of a thousand 
paper cranes arrived for Nice Nature.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature is staring intently at that 
fan letter.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even making a thousand paper cranes for 
someone like me...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
A thousand, you know. A whole thousand. 
Just how long did that even take...?
choice_data_list:
That's just how much they're rooting for 
you.
That's just how much I'm rooting for you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Alright, time to head out for training!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...At the very least, I have to look cool 
enough to match what I've been given.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After neatly arranging the thousand 
origami cranes by the window, she headed 
out to the track.
